note: Top navigation bar -- renders: Wikipedia logo, search box, main menu, user links (Donate/Log in/Create account)
Table of contents -- renders: section headings (Background, Terminology, Structure, etc.) which are fixed article structure
Page title bar -- renders: article title 'HTTP cookie' and language selector
Left navigation tabs -- renders: Article, Talk
Right navigation tabs -- renders: Read, View source, View history, Tools
Appearance settings -- renders: Font size (Small/Medium/Large), Width (Limited/Full), Theme (OS/Day/Night)
Site subtitle -- renders: 'From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia'
Footer -- renders: copyright info, Privacy policy, About Wikipedia, Disclaimers, Contact, Mobile view
